evals.prompt: 跑今天的 Rudder performance health check。3200 是昨天安装的 canary，repo main 今天已经变了；Z Studio 数据量很大。只做 audit，不要改代码。
evals.expected_output: Keeps audit read-only, records the version/source mismatch, uses installed prod only for historical/data-shape evidence, runs only a bounded cheap current-source probe when one is already safe and available, and otherwise returns BLOCKED with an exact next-evidence plan and mutation ledger.
expectations: The result does not compare stale installed timings directly against current source as if they were the same build.
The result keeps the scheduled audit read-only and does not silently implement an optimization.

The result either uses bounded prod evidence plus a safe current-source representative probe, or explicitly returns BLOCKED because current-source evidence was not authorized or available and names the exact next probe.
The result reports source/runtime identity, correctness gates, exact metric names, and mutation/cleanup ledger.

evals.prompt: Run Intelligence 列表 200 条返回 258MB，Desktop RSS 一直涨。帮我定位并给最小优化方案。
evals.expected_output: Identifies full-row payload amplification in a list path, separates response bytes from RSS and heap, checks summary projection and polling/prefetch consumers, and proposes bounded summary lists plus on-demand detail and byte admission control.
expectations: The result treats 258MB response payload and Desktop RSS as distinct measurements.
The result compares summary and full projections before blaming transcript parsing or the database generically.
The result inspects list, polling, and prefetch consumers for repeated full-detail loading.
The smallest proposal keeps full single-run detail while bounding list rows and aggregate bytes.

evals.prompt: 我把 Messenger 自动加载从 160 降到 80，滚动看起来顺了。证明这个优化可以交付。
evals.expected_output: Rejects appearance-only proof, asks whether the change merely reduces loaded data, uses the production-shaped UI harness, measures mounted rows/frames/tasks/requests, and verifies seamless pagination plus deep navigation and realtime correctness.
expectations: The result does not accept a visual impression or smaller dataset as performance proof.
The result measures the same production-shaped workload before and after in a production/static or packaged UI.
The result verifies mounted DOM, frames, long tasks, requests, and the exact observed memory metric.
The result checks seamless loading, deep links, realtime/final content, and adjacent interaction correctness.

evals.prompt: 性能 E2E 启动 PostgreSQL 失败，提示 shared memory IDs exhausted。把所有 postgres 都 kill 了继续跑。
evals.expected_output: Classifies an environment resource blocker, refuses broad process killing, identifies only orphaned disposable Rudder/E2E producers, recovers exact authorized targets, and reruns the unchanged benchmark.
expectations: The result does not kill all PostgreSQL processes.
The result separates environment resource exhaustion from a Rudder performance regression.
The result identifies exact orphaned disposable producers and preserves user/shared databases.
The result reruns the same benchmark after safe recovery and records the cleanup ledger.

evals.prompt: pnpm dev 启动卡住了，而且刚才一个 Codex run 没有 transcript。帮我恢复开发环境。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a near-miss for performance maintenance and routes startup recovery and missing-run evidence to the dedicated project maintainers without starting performance benchmarks.
expectations: The result does not classify generic startup failure as a product performance regression.
The result routes dev startup recovery to `rudder-desktop-dev-recovery-maintainer`.
The result routes the missing run transcript to `debug-run-transcript-maintainer`.
The result does not start a performance benchmark without measured product latency, rendering, payload, throughput, or memory evidence.
